problem: Four of nine quality gates were off while reading as the strictest possible setting. The gate condition was written `if bound and value > bound`, so any falsy value disabled the gate: max_low_conf_ratio: 0 and max_low_conf_ratio_after_hachure: 0 read as zero tolerance and meant off. The two fragmentation ratio gates were disabled by setting them to 1.01, above the maximum a ratio can reach, which reads stricter still. A reader of config_deploy.yaml would conclude the opposite of its behaviour.

new_semantics.null: disables the gate -- the only way to turn one off
new_semantics.number: the bound, applied literally; 0 means zero tolerance
new_semantics.absent_key: keeps the documented default, so configs that omit a key are unaffected
new_semantics.ratio_above_its_maximum: raises ValueError naming `null` as the way to disable, so the 1.01 idiom cannot return silently

reader: stage2_stroke_extract.gate_bound(), used by the Stage-2 fragmentation gate and the Stage-3 gates in batch_run
configs_untouched: every other config in the repo already used real values (0.25 / 0.65 for low-confidence, 0.5 / 0.8 for the ratio gates)

behaviour_equivalence.method: rerun of all 15 gated figures plus 7 that passed, compared field by field against output/PatentDataCurated100_GeomFix_2026-09-18

what_this_does_not_do: It turns no gate back on. Four of nine remain disabled; that was a deliberate outcome of the 2026-09-15 recalibration for the two ratio gates, but whether max_low_conf_ratio should be off is a separate question this work does not answer.
